etymologies.etymologyHTML: From optimist +‎ -ic.

definitions.definition: Expecting the best in all possible ways.

quote.citation: 1944 November and December, “What's in a Name?”, in Railway Magazine, page 333:
quote.text: Reference was made in the January-February issue to some of the optimistic railway titles of the past, such as the Manchester & Milford, and the Lancashire, Derbyshire & East Coast, neither of which got anywhere near the extremities indicated in their titles during their independent existence.

definitions.definition: (computing) Allowing other processes to perform transactions on the same data at the same time, and checking for conflicts only when changes need to be written back.
